title: Is that really HMCTS? How to spot a scam

content.text: In this episode of Inside HMCTS, Matt from our counter fraud team explains how scammers are targeting the public by pretending to be HMCTS.

He shares the warning signs to look out for, how to spot fraudulent calls and emails, what to do if you think you've been targeted, and where to report suspicious activity. The episode also covers fake enforcement officer scams and common myths about fraud.
Listen to the latest episode now, available wherever you get your podcasts from!
A transcript of the podcast is also available.
